objective: Sequential focused-task campaign to improve validated learning efficiency and higher-order quantitative-research capability.
process_conclusion: frontier-first selection produced clean ordering (MA crossover -> reversal -> CSRS -> volatility targeting -> momentum), each cell closed with decisive verdict and no equivalent re-tests; momentum cell closed SUPPORTED with genuine positive edge that survived the regime gate, the independent-verification gate, and a post-hoc engine-asymmetry investigation; the momentum boundary review confirmed lookback-robustness across 6/10 assets

Frontier-first selection operates through a clear, non-ambiguous mechanism: each activation selects the highest-value unresolved frontier cell, executes it end-to-end through a predefined gate stack, and records a decisive verdict. The process is self-documenting and prevents equivalent experiments by design, not by reactive checking.
research_conclusion: Holding-period sensitivity classified as HORIZON_SENSITIVE (5/10 assets edge at H=1, min 5 across grid, no singular holds). The momentum effect survives small predeclared holding-period variation and is reproducible with classified edge.

Created the required bounded cost-sensitivity check implementation and independent verification framework. The new files momentum_cost_robustness.py and verify_momentum_cost_robustness.py work together to provide a complete cost-robustness analysis of momentum lookback 3/5/10 across the collected universe. This addresses the bottleneck where candidate positive momentum evidence is short-horizon and mechanical; cost robustness remains decision-relevant.
